name: the-max-mix
description: THE MAX MIX: a fun collaborative Spotify tablet for Raspberry Pi 4 with Waveshare 7-inch touchscreen

scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test && bash scripts/test-kiosk.sh
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint && npm run lint:root
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix server run test:coverage && npm --prefix client run test:coverage
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run lint:shell
